title: The Maharashtra Apartment Ownership Act, 1970
full_text: The Maharashtra Apartment Ownership Act, 1970 Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 197115 Act Number: 15 Enactment Date: 1971-02-19 Act Year: 1971 Short Title: The Maharashtra Apartment Ownership Act, 1970 Long Title: An Act to provide for the ownership of an individual apartment in a building and to make such apartment heritable and transferable property.
